exposure: awareness of evidence for azithromycin use
outcome: reported use of azithromycin prophylaxis for cesarean deliveries (scheduled and unscheduled)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 66 OB/GYN providers in Alabama who responded to an online survey, 44 of whom performed cesarean deliveries.
finding: Only 56.8% of Alabama obstetrics providers reported using azithromycin for CD prophylaxis, with use being associated with urban patient populations and higher-level hospitals.
cross-section timing: At the time of the online survey administration
